extracted.name: Excellent Venison Soup
extracted.description: Venison is delicious and healthy in this rich-flavored soup packed with cabbage, rutabagas, and parsnips.
ingredient_lines: 1 (16 ounce) can whole peeled tomatoes, with liquid
instruction_lines: Brown venison and onions in a large pot over medium heat. Mix in onion, parsnip, potatoes, carrots, rutabagas, tomatoes, bouillon, water, cabbage, bay leaf, oregano, salt, and pepper. Bring to a boil, reduce heat to low, and simmer 1 to 2 hours.
